studios.monetization.hintOn: Games in this studio can charge KR through KR triggers and PAYMENTS.charge.
studios.monetization.hintOff: KR triggers and PAYMENTS.charge are disabled in this studio's games until the studio is approved for monetization.

studios.monetization.hintBlocked: This studio can no longer apply for monetization.

studios.monetization.rule1.title: Original work only.
studios.monetization.rule1.text: Your maps must be your studio's own work. No reuploads, ripped maps or barely changed templates.
studios.monetization.rule2.title: Free to finish.
studios.monetization.rule2.text: Every map must be fully playable and completable without paying. Skips aren't allowed on maps that pay out KR rewards.
studios.monetization.rule3.title: Clear prices.
studios.monetization.rule3.text: Always show the price and exactly what the player gets before they pay.
studios.monetization.rule4.title: No gambling.
studios.monetization.rule4.text: Players must never pay for a chance to win KR, tradable items or anything worth something outside your map, and players can't bet against each other. Prize wheels may only award items and currencies that stay in your map, and must show the cost and the odds of every prize.
studios.monetization.rule5.title: No paying to beat other players.
studios.monetization.rule5.text: Nothing a player buys may change a round against other players: no nukes, no damaging, slowing or penalising others, no team-wide effects. Upgrades and boosts are only allowed where players fight the map, not each other.
studios.monetization.rule6.title: No entry fees.
studios.monetization.rule6.text: Never charge players to join, play or stay in a map.
studios.monetization.rule7.title: No spam or pressure.
studios.monetization.rule7.text: Keep purchases in a store or clearly marked spots. No flooding the map with paid triggers or prompts, no fake timers, no misleading prompts, and no promising rewards you don't deliver.
studios.monetization.rule8.title: Krunker's rules apply.
studios.monetization.rule8.text: Maps, names, thumbnails and studio skins must follow the Krunker Terms. No NSFW, hate, impersonation or stolen assets.
studios.monetization.rule9.title: Enforcement.
studios.monetization.rule9.text: We can review your maps at any time. Breaking these rules can get monetization revoked. Serious or repeated breaks stop the studio and its owner from applying again.
